stories.title: Fever guard Lexie Hull weds longtime boyfriend in weekend ceremony
stories.summary: Hull and her new husband, Will Matthiessen, were wed Nov. 21 in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, the couple shared in an exclusive interview with PEOPLE.

stories.title: Domestic violence can create unsafe homes for the holidays
stories.summary: There are signs to look out for during the holidays that could help a loved one out of a domestic violence relationship.

stories.title: Community mourns Tippecanoe County family as DCS report reveals prior abuse allegations
stories.summary: The Indiana Department of Child Services says the agency had opened an investigation into allegations of physical abuse and domestic violence.

stories.title: Shelter animals 'crash' Thanksgiving in Hancock County
stories.summary: The goal of the promotion is to get local families to foster shelter animals for the holiday weekend.

stories.title: Indianapolis police, bars prepare for 'Blackout Wednesday' crowds
stories.summary: The night has earned nicknames like "Blackout Wednesday" and "Drinksgiving" as people returning home for Thanksgiving go to bars before the holiday.

stories.title: Death investigation underway after woman pulled from Indianapolis pond
stories.summary: A woman died after being pulled from a pond at a northwest Indianapolis apartment complex Wednesday afternoon.

stories.title: 'A plea out to the community' | Humane Society for Hamilton County hosting Black Friday adoption event
stories.summary: The Humane Society for Hamilton County will host a Black Friday adoption event to help animals in its care. Six of the animals will have adoption fees waived.

stories.title: Amazon driver accused of battering Henry County resident while delivering package
stories.summary: A Middletown resident was hospitalized after a confrontation with an Amazon delivery driver during a package delivery, according to police.

stories.title: 2 men, 1 woman charged after allegedly pistol whipping, robbing 'friend' of $4,000 tax check cash
stories.summary: On Oct. 8, Angel Craig, Russell Callahan and Aaron Manuel allegedly picked up a woman from her home, made her cash her tax check and then robbed her with a handgun.

stories.title: Warrant issued for Bartholomew County man accused of molesting 3 boys under 12 years old
stories.summary: Documents allege Jamie Joyner told the one of the boys if he ever reported the sexual abuse to anyone, he would "murder them."

stories.title: Court docs: Former Andy Mohr Ford employee charged in alleged theft of more than $250,000
stories.summary: Brandy Wells, 49, was charged on Nov. 24 in the Hendricks Circuit Court with one count of theft and one count of corrupt business influence.

stories.title: Game on? Braun, Rokita trade barbs over potential 2028 Indiana gubernatorial matchup
stories.summary: The attorney general pushed back on Gov. Mike Braun’s comments about campaigning and governing — and aired a growing list of grievances with the administration.
